digest:
## 🔬 Major Technical Developments

### Notion just turned its workspace into a hub for AI agents
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/notion-just-turned-its-workspace-into-a-hub-for-ai-agents/
Platform play: Notion becomes the orchestration layer for enterprise AI agents
Notion is positioning itself as the connective tissue between disparate AI agents, external data, and custom code. This is a bet that the future of productivity isn't a single AI assistant but a coordinated swarm of specialized agents operating within a unified workspace. Watch for Salesforce and Microsoft to respond aggressively.

### Anthropic's Cat Wu says that, in the future, AI will anticipate your needs before you know what they are
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/anthropics-cat-wu-says-that-in-the-future-ai-will-anticipate-your-needs-before-you-know-what-they-are/
Proactive AI is the next product frontier for Claude
The head of Claude Code and Cowork is telegraphing Anthropic's roadmap: moving from reactive assistants to systems that initiate actions autonomously. This has massive implications for enterprise automation and will accelerate the agent wars. The company shipping reliable proactive AI first captures enormous switching costs.

### Amazon launches an AI shopping assistant for the search bar, powered by Alexa+
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/amazon-launches-an-ai-shopping-assistant-for-the-search-bar-powered-by-alexa/
Amazon embeds agentic commerce across its entire surface area
Alexa for Shopping works across mobile, desktop, and Echo Show, automating purchases not just on Amazon but across other retailers. This is Amazon weaponizing its distribution to own the AI commerce layer. Expect affiliate economics and retail media networks to face significant disruption.


## 💼 Business & Market Signals

### Anduril raises $5B, doubles valuation to $61B
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/anduril-raises-5b-doubles-valuation-to-61b/
Defense tech now commands big tech multiples
Anduril hit $2.2B revenue in 2025 and just raised at roughly 28x trailing revenue with Thrive and a16z leading. This signals institutional conviction that defense software margins will hold and that Anduril is becoming a prime contractor, not just a vendor. The valuation premium reflects expected acceleration from autonomous systems programs.

### Anthropic now has more business customers than OpenAI, according to Ramp data
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/anthropic-now-has-more-business-customers-than-openai-according-to-ramp-data/
Enterprise market share has quietly flipped to Anthropic
Ramp expense data shows 34.4% of participating businesses paying for Anthropic versus 32.3% for OpenAI. This is the first concrete signal that Anthropic's enterprise focus and reliability positioning is translating to commercial momentum. Combined with the small business push announced today, Anthropic is executing a full-stack go-to-market offensive.

### Geothermal startup Fervo Energy pops 33% in IPO debut fueled by AI data center demand
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/geothermal-startup-fervo-energy-pops-33-in-ipo-debut-fueled-by-ai-data-center-demand/
Clean baseload power is now a public market story
Fervo's IPO was upsized multiple times due to oversubscription, with the 33% pop signaling strong demand for AI infrastructure energy plays. Enhanced geothermal offers 24/7 carbon-free power without the intermittency of solar and wind. Hyperscalers desperate for clean power capacity are the obvious off-takers.

### Rivian spinoff Mind Robotics raises another $400M
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/rivian-spinoff-mind-robotics-raises-another-400m/
Rivian's robotics bet has quietly crossed $1B in funding
Mind Robotics, revealed in late 2025, now has over $1B in capital despite limited public visibility. Rivian is leveraging its EV manufacturing and software stack for adjacent robotics applications. The capital intensity suggests either humanoid robots or industrial automation at scale.


## 📋 Case Studies & Deep Dives

### MacBook Neo Deep Dive: Benchmarks, Wafer Economics, and the 8GB Gamble
URL: https://www.jdhodges.com/blog/macbook-neo-benchmarks-analysis/
Apple's margin optimization meets silicon economics
A detailed technical analysis of Apple's latest chip economics and memory configuration choices. The 8GB base RAM decision continues to generate friction, but the wafer economics suggest Apple is optimizing for gross margin preservation rather than user experience. Worth reading for anyone modeling Apple's services-hardware bundle strategy.

### Musk's xAI is running nearly 50 gas turbines unchecked at its Mississippi data center
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/13/musks-xai-is-running-nearly-50-gas-turbines-unchecked-at-its-mississippi-data-center/
Regulatory arbitrage meets AI infrastructure buildout
xAI's Colossus 2 data center is facing a lawsuit over its use of "mobile" gas turbines to circumvent permitting requirements. This is a case study in how AI labs are prioritizing speed over compliance to secure compute capacity. The legal exposure creates headline risk, but the underlying behavior reflects industry-wide desperation for power.

### The US is winning the AI race where it matters most: commercialization
URL: https://avkcode.github.io/blog/us-winning-ai-race.html
Revenue, not research papers, defines AI leadership
An analysis arguing that US dominance in AI is best measured by commercial deployment and revenue generation rather than benchmark performance. The piece examines how American companies are converting model capabilities into enterprise contracts and consumer products faster than international competitors. Useful framing for assessing competitive positioning.


## ⚡ Signal vs. Noise

The theme today is infrastructure and distribution, not model capability. Anthropic is winning enterprise share while pushing downmarket, Notion is becoming an agent orchestration layer, and Amazon is embedding AI commerce into every surface. Meanwhile, the power bottleneck is now a public market opportunity with Fervo's IPO, and defense tech is commanding big tech valuations. The companies capturing value are those controlling the integration points and energy supply, not those chasing the next benchmark. The AI race is increasingly about deployment velocity and regulatory navigation.
